episodes.title: Rise or Die
episodes.summary: The elite plot against rioters; horses are sold for the Roman Games; an African family is kidnapped.

episodes.title: Trust None
episodes.summary: Tenax and Domitian form a racing faction and recruit Scorpus; Vespasian ponders on his successor.

episodes.title: Death's Door
episodes.summary: Kwame and Viggo bond; Queen Berenice warns Titus of Domitian's plans; Vespasian picks an heir.

episodes.title: Fool's Bet
episodes.summary: Titus shuts down the Gold Faction; Scorpus joins the White Faction; Tenax meets a man from his past.

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.summary: Titus rehabilitates his image; Tenax's past is revealed; Kwame prepares for his fight with Flamma.

episodes.title: Blood Relation
episodes.summary: Mount Vesuvius erupts; Titus punishes Marsus and the Patricians; Tenax is wounded in a battle.

episodes.title: Death's Bed
episodes.summary: Tenax reveals his past to Cala; Andria and Fonsoa win races; Kwame faces Flamma in a rematch.

episodes.title: All or Nothing
episodes.summary: After a racetrack accident, Elia blames Scorpus; Elia joins the Blue Faction for revenge.

episodes.title: The Die Is Cast
episodes.summary: Elia enters a revenge race with Scorpus; Tenax puts on a public execution for the Patricians.

episodes.title: Let the Games Begin
episodes.summary: Kwame and Viggo fight; Tenax spares a life in exchange for help; Domitian pulls one over on Titus.
